changes.comment: Add hydration helpers for prerendered pages: `fetchRecord()` answers identical GET and HEAD requests from the page's hydration island, `replaceNonTemplateChildren()` takes `{ identity }` (from `templateIdentity()` or `htmlIdentity()`) and returns `"adopted"` when the server already rendered that source, `holdHydration()` keeps hydration open for start-up work and `whenHydrated()` resolves when it ends
Add `NO_SSR_ATTR`, the name of the `no-ssr` attribute that keeps a region of a page out of a prerender
